title: Intellectual Property Rights
definition: Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) are legal rights that protect creations of the mind—such as inventions, literary and artistic works, designs, and symbols—granting creators exclusive rights to use and commercialize their intellectual assets for a specified period.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (TRIPS agreement, GI tags, WIPO treaties, statutory bodies) and Mains GS Paper 3 (Innovation, R&D, Make in India, compulsory licensing, pharmaceutical pricing, technology transfer).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Intellectual Property Rights.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Indian legal framework
